decisions.evidence: SCERT Tripura p.51 prints 5 3/7 = ((5 times 7)+3)/3 = 38/7; the intermediate denominator 3 is inconsistent.
decisions.decision: Reject that worked conversion as mathematical authority. The preceding general verbal formula may inform terminology only. Preserve the OpenStax numbers and calculations.

decisions.decision: Use namespaced section-relative XPath keys in nodes rather than adding or inventing source IDs. Each mapped element keeps its existing children and order; array length is children plus one.

decisions.decision: The parent explicitly approved translating these linguistic labels. This narrows the previous byte-identical MathML rule only for allowlisted mtext contents. Translate the four aria-labels as an explicit language-attribute exception.
